header.cleanBody:
(Your Start Step)
Move an opposing Cost 6 Spirit to your Field in the same state it is in. You can use the Spirit you moved during this turn as your Spirit. When you do, the cores on the moved Spirit are treated as that owned by its owner; cores can't be moved from that Spirit, or sent to that Spirit. When the turn ends, return that Spirit to the opposing Field in exhausted state.
